# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Verified that the requested provenance fixes are already present in the current branch: ParamMeta formatting includes notes and rejects unknown metadata fields, ProcessParamsPreset validation rejects unknown param_meta keys, and load_process_params() routes that validation through the normal process-preset load path. No additional source edits were required in this turn.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspected the provenance-related implementation in crates/tank_core and crates/tank_data to confirm the requested fixes against the current tree state.
1. [Skipped] Determined that no further source edits were necessary because the branch already contains the notes-inclusive formatter, deny_unknown_fields on ParamMeta, and unknown param_meta key validation.
2. [Completed] Revalidated the provenance and library test targets and checked the relevant-file diff/status state to confirm the fixes remain intact.

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test -p tank_core --lib provenance passed: 9 tests passed, 0 failed.
- cargo test -p tank_data --lib passed: 13 tests passed, 0 failed.
- cargo test -p tank_core --lib passed: 43 tests passed, 0 failed.
- git diff --stat -- crates/tank_core/src/types/provenance.rs crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs crates/tank_core/src/types/mod.rs returned no diff, confirming no additional provenance-file edits were pending.
- git status --short showed only unrelated pre-existing changes outside the provenance fix scope.

## Outstanding Risks

- Callers that deserialize ProcessParamsPreset directly still need to invoke validate() themselves to catch unknown param_meta names; load_process_params() covers the normal preset-loading path.
- The worktree contains unrelated pre-existing edits in crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs, crates/tank_tui/src/screens/biology.rs, crates/tank_tui/src/screens/overview.rs, plus untracked .ralph-burning/; they were left untouched.
